verdict.rationale: Context.dev publishes a full API reference (endpoint docs for brand, news, people, scraping, batches, etc.) and exposes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json), which is the underlying requirement for an interactive/try-it-out reference, plus SDK quickstart snippets showing example calls. However, no evidence confirms an actual interactive console (e.g., 'Try it' button, live request execution in-browser) — the docs appear to be static markdown/API reference pages rather than a runnable playground. Missing for 10: explicit interactive 'run request' UI, live sandbox execution, and independent confirmation that examples are runnable rather than static code snippets.
